Abstract base class defining the caching strategy for GitHub API responses and contributor leaderboard data. It implements a **stale-while-revalidate** pattern: serve cached data immediately while asynchronously refreshing stale entries in the background.

## Key Components

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `getGitHubApiResponse(...)` | Fetches/caches paginated GitHub API results keyed by city, language, and page number |
| `getHttpResponse(...)` | Fetches/caches contributor lists keyed by city, region, state, team, language, and result count |
| `isCacheEntryStale(...)` | Checks entry age against a configurable refresh interval |
| `doHttpCallAsync(...)` | `@Async` background refresh that updates a stale cache entry without blocking the caller |
| `doHttpCall(...)` | Synchronous supplier invocation with automatic cache write on success |
| `get(...)` / `put(...)` / `invalidate(...)` | Abstract CRUD operations implemented by concrete subclasses (Redis, in-memory, etc.) |
| `isCacheReady()` / `setCacheIsReady(...)` | Readiness flag used by the Cache Updater service to signal warm-up completion |
| `forceCacheUpdate()` / `setCacheMode(...)` | Toggles `FORCE_UPDATE` mode to bypass cached reads and always call the upstream supplier |
| `generateCacheKey(...)` / `generateGithubCacheKey(...)` | Builds delimiter-separated composite keys from filter parameters |

**Configuration properties:**

| Property | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `github.cache.refresh.interval` | — | TTL for GitHub API cache entries |
| `http.cache.refresh.interval` | — | TTL for contributor list cache entries |
| `cache.expiration.ms` | `3600000` | Hard expiration applied by subclasses |
| `cache.should.be.ready` | `false` | Enables readiness-gate enforcement |

## Usage Example

```java
// Concrete subclass wires in a storage backend (e.g., Redis)
@Service
public class RedisCacheService extends CacheServiceAbs {

    @Override
    public <T> Optional<T> get(String cachePath, String key,
                               TypeToken<T> typeRef, Long refreshInterval) {
        // deserialize from Redis
    }

    @Override
    public <T> void put(String cachePath, String key, T value) {
        // serialize to Redis
    }

    @Override
    public String getDelimiter() { return ":"; }
}

// Leaderboard API handler
Optional<List<Contributor>> result = cacheService.getHttpResponse(
    "chicago", null, "IL", "fire", "java", 25, () -> githubClient.fetchContributors(...)
);
```
